bounded_hypothesis: If workflow guidance is independently adapted and validated for all five supported locales, non-English users can inspect and execute the same routing contract without an English prose fallback.
candidate_delta: Extend --lang from EN/KO to EN/KO/JA/ZH-CN/ZH-TW, add locale-native workflow labels/prompts/suffixes and chrome, normalize common Chinese locale aliases, and make doctor reject incomplete locale bundles.
rollback_gate: Revert if any supported locale falls back to English prose, loses a protected command/ID, or makes doctor accept an incomplete locale bundle.
first_failure_rule: Any missing locale field or English user-facing fallback in JA/ZH-CN/ZH-TW fails the repair.
claim_boundary: This closes deterministic CLI copy parity. It does not establish route-level UI overflow or host-model adherence.
next: Build the package, execute every locale flag through the real CLI, and verify installed workflow-capabilities parity across channels.
